name: Body Size Adjustment
description: Allows physical mass compression into a compact form for stealth or expansion into apex battle size.

name: Celestial Polarity Surge
description: Alternates polar radiant light and abyssal void energy, preventing elemental attunement by enemies.

name: Controlled Weight Flow
description: Redistributes massive weight through spiritual resonance to tread feather-light or strike with mountain weight.

name: Darkvision
description: Clear sight in total non-magical and cave darkness without distortion.

name: Endless Growth
description: Grows continuously in mass and height across its lifespan through layered absorption of stone and minerals.

name: Explosive Power
description: Unleashes immense kinetic force in short, deceptive bursts for lethal pounces and rapid strikes.

name: Fast Regeneration
description: Rapidly restores physical and spiritual damage using ambient natural mana when rooted in terrain.

name: Feline Agility
description: Blessed with extreme flexibility, speed, balance, and lightning reaction time outclassing standard beasts.

name: Flame Ward Marking
description: Allies marked by beast are granted absolute immunity to ambient flame damage under its sphere of control.

name: Geo-Resonance Sense
description: Detects vibrations, subterranean movement, and mana flow through stone and soil over vast distances.

name: Half-Spirit Body
description: 50% immunity to environmental toxins, paralysis, curses, and spiritual soul erosion.

name: High Mana Regeneration
description: Constantly channels ambient mana from the surrounding environment to sustain itself and its pact tamer.

name: Hoard Resonance
description: Passive combat empowerment and vitality recovery fueled by hoarded gems and mineral treasures.

name: Iceveil Chill
description: Sub-zero body temperature control that masks heat signatures and cools the tamer in thermal extremes.

name: Lesser Draconic Majesty
description: Passive intimidation aura causing lesser reptiles and non-draconic beasts to freeze in terror.

name: Moon-Shadow Instincts
description: Night Phase: Passive evasion amplification, lunar reflex sharpening, and dim-light invisibility.

name: Natural Habitat Harmonisation
description: Body mineral leakage forms thriving micro-ecosystems of moss, flora, and mineral crystals wherever it rests.

name: Obsidian Hide
description: Natural resistance to physical blows and enhanced durability. Deflects blades and elemental strikes.

name: Pack Instinct
description: Amplifies spatial coordination, ambush reflexes, and combat efficacy when near allies.

name: Primordial Shadow Step
description: Instantaneous teleportation between shadows across distances through spatial-shadow tethering.

name: Silent Predator
description: Fluid stealth movement allowing seamless, soundless stalking in natural and dark environments.

name: Sun-Blessed Physique
description: Day Phase: Solar empowerment enhancing kinetic force, daylight strike speed, and radiant vitality.

name: Swarm Command
description: Commands and coordinates rodent swarms for scouting, reconnaissance, and battlefield harvesting.

name: Titanic Endurance
description: Massive stamina capacity and stone tissues that disperse kinetic shocks and heat harmlessly across mass.

name: Tough Body
description: Bark-textured skin granting monstrous physical strike resistance, elemental deflection, and erosion immunity.

name: Triple-Aura Ferocity
description: Projects simultaneous tripartite aura pulses that suppress enemy mana flow and cause panic in prey.
